purpose: Earn the first small yes and make sure the right person is on the line.
success_indicators: The prospect stays on the line

purpose: Verify ownership before spending time on the pitch.
exact_script: This is {name}. I'm working near your building on {address} in {city}. Do you still own that building?

part_title: Give the reason for the call
purpose: Use local relevance and the storm date to create a credible reason to continue.
exact_script: We got called out to inspect a few properties up the street from you and have been finding some pretty bad hail damage. Did you have someone inspect your building after the storm on {hail_date}?
success_indicators: The prospect answers the inspection question
The conversation moves to condition or documentation
common_mistakes: Failing to pause for the answer

purpose: Stay credible when the named contact is unavailable or uncertain.
exact_script: I'm working near the property on {address} in {city}. Do you still own that building?
success_indicators: The building owner or decision-maker is identified
